text:
```yaml
name: Release Please

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '16'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install -g @google-github-actions/release-please-action

      - name: Create or update release PR
        id: create_release_pr
        run: echo "::set-output name=pr_number::$(npx release-please pr --config=.github/repo-sync-config.json --repo-url=https://github.com/openclaw-rocks/openclaw-operator.git)"

      - name: Check if PR was created
        if: ${{ steps.create_release_pr.outputs.pr_number != '' }}
        run: echo "Release PR created successfully"

      - name: Wait for PR to be merged
        if: ${{ steps.create_release_pr.outputs.pr_number != '' }}
        run: echo "Waiting for PR #${{ steps.create_release_pr.outputs.pr_number }} to be merged"
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Trigger release workflow on tag creation
        if: ${{ github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref_type == 'tag' }}
        run: echo "Triggering release workflow on tag creation"
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
```
